determineSkillOfTestStep: Determine skill of test. Skill test of that type begins.
commitCardsFromHandToSkillTestStep: Commit cards from hand to skill test.
skipTriggersActiveNotice: Skip Triggers is on — fast triggers unrelated to this test are being hidden.
fastWindowBeforeCommit: {'{'}fast{'}'} Player window: play fast cards or abilities before committing cards.
fastWindowBeforeReveal: {'{'}fast{'}'} Player window: last chance for fast effects before the chaos token is revealed.
winOddsHint: Chance to succeed with the tokens left in the chaos bag. An estimate: effects that reveal extra tokens are not fully modeled.
activeModifiersHint: Bonuses already applied to this test by your cards and abilities (hover one to see its source card). They are not cards to commit.
